The pre-streaming world:
November 1995
My friends and I were walking on a subdivision street (no sidewalk) on a snowy night. A car turns onto the street ahead of us. It stops. Flashes its lights. Guns it and comes at us, fishtailing in the snow! Confused looks between us.. Do we run??
But the car slows and pulls up to us. It's my friend Terry's older brother Corey and his friend Christian. They're driving around because they just heard this new song "Wonderwall" earlier today and the only way for them to hear it again is to wait for it to come on the car radio, before they can go buy the CD (and a CD player..) in another town because ours doesn't have a store for such fancy things...

Corey was in a band called Big Fish Eat Little Fish, with Richard Reed Perry, now of Arcade Fire.

Christian worked at the nice video store in town and wouldn't let us rent the animated movie Heavy Metal because it was rated R. So we went to the sketchy video store a block away and rented it there 🤘.
